entities.summary: Jaime Sunye Neto is a Brazilian chess player. Awarded the International Master title in 1980 and the Grandmaster title in 1986, he was Brazilian champion seven times, in 1976, 1977, 1979, 1980, 1981, 1982 and 1983. Sunye Neto was also president of the Brazilian Chess Confederation from 1988 to 1992.
